Message:
Because of Loki’s reading,
I know full well that my soul
will fall into Hell.

I will save the world,
and in my final moments,
use my soul as bait to drag
all the demons down
into the abyss with me.
That is how my life is to be used.

I am certain I will not be able to
endure the torments of Hell.

My sullied soul will break
as it is being torn apart—
suffering, and wailing in agony.

There was a time when I foolishly
called that atonement.
But now...I know it is not.

For I learned something
from Alexandra,
after hearing her plead
for me not to give up.

That atoning for my sins
with my life is no reason
to give up on living.

I shall live on.
Not so that I may be forgiven,

but to save as many people as I can,
while carrying the weight of
all my unforgivable sins.

That is the true atonement
permitted to me.

O God.
If You would still allow
this foolish sinner to pray...

Please...guide the souls of
the sacrificed to Heaven.

And from up above,
I ask that they watch over me.

Watch over me...
as I fall into Hell below.

And, watch over me as I live this day,
with these sins upon my soul.
